title: breynia poilanei
intro: Breynia poilanei, commonly known as the Vietnamese shrub or Five-angled Peppers, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Breynia poilanei include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
